text: From a regular home clean to a multi-storey commercial site, Stayclean brings the right method, equipment and experience without turning a simple job into a drama.
Reliable regular and one-off cleans across Bristol. Glass, frames, sills and doors are cleaned with pure water from the safety of the ground.
Flexible, professional cleaning for shops, offices, schools, blocks and managed sites, with minimal disruption to your day.
Safe, practical access for awkward and high glazing using water-fed poles and powered access where the job requires it.
Local roots. Modern equipment. A service people stick with.
